# Vocabulary: effect

How a technique changes a mechanic (attribute of the technique→mechanic `affects` edge).

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `replaces-substrate` | Replaces substrate | Swaps the mechanic's implementation (e.g., hand-written utility AI → LLM policy) while keeping its player-facing role. |
| `deepens` | Deepens | Same mechanic, much higher fidelity, scale, or variety than was feasible. |
| `enables-new` | Enables new form | Makes a qualitatively new version of the mechanic possible. |
| `cuts-authoring-cost` | Cuts authoring cost | Reduces developer cost of content the mechanic consumes. |
| `explains` | Explains | Makes the mechanic's state or causes legible to the player. |
| `tunes` | Tunes / balances | Automates balancing, testing, or parameter search for the mechanic. |
| `accelerates` | Accelerates | Same output at lower runtime compute, allowing more scale. |
